title: Cortez the Killer
tuning: D A D G B D
feel: Slow half-time groove (Hooktheory counts 114); a 7½-minute vamp

sections.name: The vamp (whole song)
sections.note: Repeated throughout; the solos run over the same loop. Add hammer-ons inside Em7 and on the B string over Am11.

why: A **modal vamp with common-tone voice leading** — the open top strings hold G–B–D across all three chords — and a first altered tuning.
hard_change: Keeping **hammer-on embellishments in time** across the 4-bar cycle.
theory: i7–♭VII–iv7 in E Aeolian. The open D on top makes every chord a 7th or 11th.
steps: Retune to double drop D (both E strings down to D). Changes alone, slowly.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 80 bpm), adding one hammer-on per bar.
With the record — the whole 7½ minutes.
